def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    rows={r for r,n in Counter(r for r,c in markers).items() if n>=2}
    cols={c for r,n in Counter(c for r,c in markers).items() if n>=2}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in rows:
        out[r]=[1]*w
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c]=1
    return out
PY
